one_liner: The AI negotiation agent to help you save money on SaaS.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: Vendr was founded in 2018 to make software buying fast, fair, and transparent. After joining Y Combinator in 2019, founder and CEO Ryan Neu built Vendr to help companies save money on SaaS through data-driven negotiations. Following its $150M Series B, Vendr evolved from a services-led business into an AI-first company, launching Ruth—the negotiation agent trained on the world’s largest dataset of SaaS pricing and negotiation insights—to help every buyer get a fair deal automatically.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Software sales is broken. Buying SaaS still feels manual, slow, and opaque—buyers don’t know what a fair price is, and sellers spend months negotiating instead of closing deals. After leading SMB sales at HubSpot through its IPO, Ryan saw firsthand how inefficient the process had become. In 2018, he founded Vendr to fix it. Today, Vendr’s AI negotiation agent, Ruth, uses real pricing and contract data to help buyers get fair deals instantly—turning a once painful process into a transparent, data-driven transaction.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long-term vision is to fix software sales by making every transaction data-driven and fair. If we succeed, no one will overpay for software again. Buyers will use AI agents like Ruth to get transparent, market-based prices instantly—and sellers will close deals faster with trust built in. Software buying will finally be as efficient and predictable as any other modern transaction.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Ryan Neu is the founder and CEO of Vendr, creator of Ruth—the AI negotiation agent that helps companies save money on software using real pricing and contract data. Before founding Vendr, Ryan led SMB sales at HubSpot from its early days through IPO. Try Ruth for free at agent.vendr.com.

Hi everyone, we’re Juliet, Austin, Michael, and Michael. We’re the team behind [Procoto](https://procoto.com/). We’re on a mission to make procurement software more accessible and affordable for everyone.\
\
**tl;dr:** Procoto makes running RFPs, tracking contracts, and managing vendors simple and affordable. We get procurement teams out of dense systems and spreadsheets without having to drop a hefty check on SAP or Coupa.

And it’s self-service! No sales calls, redlines, or lengthy implementations. Snag our [YC launch offer](https://app.procoto.com/register?ref=yc) to get started!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71192&key=user_uploads/488165/ab363823-cd33-4b41-9d5e-05867dcf4d98)

### **😤 The problem with procurement software**

Small and mid-market companies face the same sourcing, contract, vendor, and spend management challenges of larger organizations, but with fewer resources and without the funds for an enterprise procurement platform.

* RFPs are conducted with spreadsheets and emails
* Time is wasted searching for, selecting, and inviting vendors to bid
* Contract terms, vendor information, and spend data are spread across systems
* Person hours are dedicated to data management rather than securing better rates
* Historical bidding and pricing disappear after the RFP
* The alternative solution today is a six-figure annual agreement with one of the big boys

### **😇 How we’re fixing it**

Procoto eschews (bless you) the complexity and the feature bloat of enterprise procurement software. We keep it simple and user-friendly in a tool built for everyone. Procoto automates the collection of RFP, contract, and vendor information into a centralized system and highlights savings opportunities based on historical data.

<https://youtu.be/1FCv2I6Ywho>

We lived the pain we’re solving for years and finally left to build the solution we couldn’t find Something self-service, customizable, with UI/UX from this decade, and built for users without supply chain degrees.

launches.tagline: We surface supply chain disruptions and supplier updates with email AI.
launches.body:
# **One Email Unsent - That’s all it could take for the global supply chain to crash**

The way to manage a supply chain has not changed since the invention of E-Mail and Excel.

## **What’s the problem?**

For your ordered Tesla to be produced, there are thousands of suppliers that need to be coordinated so that a single bolt missing does not halt $billions of production.

However, today, procurement teams manage this coordination through email, spreadsheets, PDFs (and, horrifyingly, sometimes even WhatsApp).

This means there are tons of supply chain disruptions not caught on time because an email or spreadsheet was not sent to or from the supplier.

**This year, due to supply chain disruptions,** [**businesses will lose over $1.6 Trillion**](https://www.accenture.com/content/dam/accenture/final/capabilities/cross-service-group/iconic-thought-leadership/document/Resiliency-in-the-making-report.pdf)

## **So how do we fix this?**

[Mandel AI](https://www.mandel.ai/) is building autonomous supply chain agents that plug into the email and ERP of manufacturers to create a real-time, self-updating source of truth for your supply chain. Our AI-powered procurement agents:

* Proactively email suppliers for order updates
* Surface supply chain disruptions and extract supplier updates (like lead times & price updates) from emails
* Save 20+ hours per week per team member

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82795&key=user_uploads/1376951/2c1d8412-6fe0-4a76-9d51-d461ec432b01)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82795&key=user_uploads/1376951/6000a50f-4441-40d4-afcb-470574a4b499)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82795&key=user_uploads/1376951/cf3b9f13-47b4-4d05-b8c2-bf5bb39865ec)

## **Why It Matters**

Procurement teams spend up to 80% of their time manually emailing suppliers for RFQs and PO update requests, leading to production delays and miscommunications that can result in millions or billions in lost sales. As Covid proved, in today's global supply chain, real-time visibility and rapid response to issues are critical for the business and the end consumer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82795&key=user_uploads/1376951/7e0f13f0-ca52-4e22-82f2-3726b9b2eaa4)

**We have already processed $50M+ in material spend and 40,000+ email threads.**

**To create your first Mandel AI agent, sign up on our website:**

### [**www.mandel.ai**](http://www.mandel.ai)

launches.title: 🌰 Hazel: AI procurement software for government
launches.tagline: Making government efficient by fixing procurement
launches.body:
### 📝 **BLUF** 

Hazel is the _only AI-native solution_ which enables public sector procurement teams to seamlessly define requirements, generate solicitations, conduct market research, and evaluate responses in one place. Public sector procurement is a time-intensive process held together by Microsoft Office, legacy point solutions, tribal knowledge, and severely overworked civil servants. Hazel is building an AI-powered platform to accelerate and streamline this mission. 

We’ve engaged hundreds of government agencies with diverse missions, and we’ve been hard at work building something they want. We’re already on contract with several governments and have received funding from agencies ranging from public school districts to the U.S. Navy!

If you know anyone supporting government procurement, please contact us! 

### 🦅 **About Us + What’s New** 

We’re Elton and August, and we along with our 3 amazing founding software engineers currently operate out of NYC, Boston, DC, and Salt Lake City. We’re excited to (finally) re-launch Hazel, an AI-native solution **which enables government procurement teams to quickly and easily manage their procurement processes**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87095&key=user_uploads/1279709/df8d3560-f897-4131-b217-b9a76fc3525c)

The two of us met in college before taking separate jobs at Palantir and Boston Consulting Group, but our focus on public service remained the same, and we saw something that we knew had to be fixed. Along the way, we’ve picked up incredible mission-driven teammates with experience from Lockheed Martin, MITRE, SpaceX, Peraton, the U.S. Air Force, the U.S. Department of State, and USAID. 

We began by building a solution for businesses to bid on RFPs because we wanted to help governments. The idea was that by bringing more businesses to the table, more competitive bids would both save governments money and deliver better performance. However, we soon realized that if our mission was to help government, we will best accomplish that by going directly B2G, not B2B2G. It means accepting the known challenges of selling to government as a startup (long sales cycles, a litany of compliance standards, nobody returns your emails, a new language of business, etc.), but nothing worthwhile - or fulfilling - comes easy.

### 🏛**️ Problem** 

Civil servants in procurement are overwhelmed. \~30% of procurement roles in government are unfilled as these employees retire or quit. Their current solutions are dated – one to two _decades_ behind the equivalent in B2B SaaS, gated behind sleepy incumbents leveraging political connections and litigation to stay on top. The lack of tools and talent means governments are more stretched than ever when it comes to buying the goods and services they need in a compliant and timely manner. This challenge is eating away at all levels of government, from local K-12 school districts to the Pentagon. As prices rise and the demands on governments grow, it becomes even more critical to strategically purchase the right tools for their success. Failure means degradation in service delivery, bad publicity, or even disaster. 

A maze of legal restrictions, understaffed departments, and growing complexity of requirements have made it near impossible to rapidly procure goods and services without defaulting to an existing incumbent. Governments would love to diversify their options or recompete… but choosing the default has shifted from a matter of convenience to an operational necessity. Over $2.7T is on the line for public procurement _annually._ 

There has never been a more pressing – or opportune – time to address the procurement challenges taxing our government’s efficiency. Climate goals require rapidly procuring sustainable and efficient energy solutions nationwide. The new era of great power competition requires procuring novel weapon systems at scale to secure democracies in the Pacific and Eastern Europe. Our aging procurement systems are creaking under their weight and cannot unlock the potential of our nation.

### 🔥 **Solution** 

Hazel’s platform accelerates and automates the rote, time-intensive tasks of researching, generating and managing solicitations. Instead of trading documents over email and doing market research via cursory Google searches, civil servants should have a single streamlined platform that assists them in doing their jobs. 

Hazel combines AI agents and a modern UI/UX to deliver a consumer-grade solution that surfaces critical information to human decision-makers, saving time and driving better outcomes. Hazel is the AI superpower for procurement teams short on staff and time but hungry for innovation and a way to do things better.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87095&key=user_uploads/1279709/ce5def23-288b-44fe-baa4-39c4fb09bcb8)

_(Screenshot of the Hazel platform) Save legal-approved boilerplates, design content sections using our AI agents, and drag-and-drop them into templates. Compliant first-draft solicitations using the agency’s template in five minutes, not five months. Edit collaboratively in real-time and seamlessly export to Word when done. No copy-paste required._ 

### **🫡 Asks** 

* Do you have any contacts in government who navigate their agency’s internal procurement processes? If so, we’d love to connect with them! 
* Reach out to us at [august@hazelai.com](mailto:august@hazelai.com) and [elton@hazelai.com](mailto:elton@hazelai.com) with any other comments, questions. **We’re building AI for the public interest** 🇺🇸

launches.title: Hazel: AI-driven marketplace for government contracts
launches.tagline: We’re using AI to enable SMBs to easily find and win public sector contract opportunities
launches.body:
### **📝 BLUF**

[Hazel](https://hazeltech.ai/) applies AI to create an equitable and accessible marketplace for businesses to bid on government contracts. Contracts are separately issued by governments, and responses must meet long lists of criteria to be compliant and award-eligible, making them immensely hard and time-consuming to write. Hazel breaks down that moat.

If you or anyone you know wants to get matched to or respond to government RFPs, please [contact us](mailto:elton@hazeltech.ai?cc=august@hazeltech.ai)!

### **🥷 About Us**

We’re [Elton](https://linkedin.com/in/eltonlossner) and [August](https://linkedin.com/in/augustschen), in SF for this YC W24 batch. We’re excited to announce Hazel, an AI-driven marketplace **that enables businesses to quickly respond to issued government RFPs in a compliant manner**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77743&key=user_uploads/1667477/121ccfbb-5ac0-49ed-b528-7c5a63f0c1a6)

The two of us met in college before taking separate jobs at Palantir and Boston Consulting Group – but our focus on mission and serving the public interest remained the same, and we saw something that we knew had to be fixed.

### **📄 Problem**

The government contracting process is broken. Contracts are separately posted on thousands of different websites and can include hundreds of pages of overlapping compliance regulations. Responding to bids can require entire business divisions supported by armies of consultants and in-house lawyers. Even the simplest of contracts – if you can find one that fits your business – require responses spanning dozens of pages, and the tiniest compliance error will jeopardize your entire submission.

The US has created a system where it is almost impossible for SMBs to win work with the government. As incumbents become even more entrenched, governments face increasing prices and deteriorating performance because they have allowed for no alternatives. With over $1T of infrastructure funding now on the line for award, the US cannot afford the status quo.

### **🧠 Solution**

Use AI to automate discovery, drafting, and compliance. Instead of spending days trawling local websites and weeks writing fruitless proposals, you should only spend minutes defining your scope of work and price.

Use Hazel to get matched to a potential contract, synthesize a draft response based on the RFP and your company information, create a checklist of to-dos, and run compliance checks. No more scrambling to register your company the day before submission. No more losing a bid because you missed a cybersecurity requirement listed on page 13 of Appendix G.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77743&key=user_uploads/1667477/88962715-f3d7-4dfb-97b6-deb758c92062)

_{Choose which sections to include in your response, view a timeline of the next steps for the process, and use GenAI to craft your answer based on existing company documentation.}_

### **📈 Asks**

* Reach out! We’re excited to help users win new bids with US government agencies, particularly at the state and local level
* Spread the word! We’ve heard from countless people how frustrating government RFP processes are. If you have any contacts involved in government RFP writing or solicitation, we’d love to connect with them

Reach out to us at [august@hazeltech.ai](mailto:august@hazeltech.ai) and [elton@hazeltech.ai](mailto:elton@hazeltech.ai) with the above or any other comments and questions. **Let’s bring more winners to government contracting.**

launches.title: Saldor: Helping businesses buy goods and services, and close their books faster
launches.body:
### Hey everyone,

We’re [Jack Cameron](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jackmcameron/) and [Jacob Bland](https://linkedin.com/in/bland-jacob) at [Saldor](https://saldor.com/) .

**TL;DR:** Saldor helps businesses buy goods and services, and close their books faster.

**The Ask**: If you work in procurement or finance, or if you’re building a company with complex purchasing needs, email us at [team@saldor.com](mailto:team@saldor.com). We’d love to talk.

**The Offer**: We’re offering customers a white-glove pilot with no implementation fee.

After a brief onboarding call, we’ll do the work required to configure Saldor, connect your existing systems, and load real company data so your team can evaluate it in a live workflow for a short period at no cost.

<https://youtu.be/szTFpL0NWpg>

**The Problem**

Buying something at a company is rarely as simple as placing an order.

An employee submits a request. Procurement checks vendors, pricing, security, and lead times. Finance reviews the budget. Legal may review a contract. Someone creates a purchase order, follows up with the vendor, tracks delivery, and eventually matches the invoice against what was ordered and received.

Many companies still manage this through email and spreadsheets, or procurement systems that are expensive and cumbersome to operate.

The problem gets worse for companies building ambitious physical infrastructure. When data centers, factories, and robotics companies cannot get the right equipment on time, entire projects can be delayed.

We saw this firsthand at Crusoe, where we helped build GPU data centers. Existing procurement systems could cost hundreds of thousands of dollars to implement, required large teams to operate, and still slowed the business down.

**Our solution**

Saldor is an AI-native procurement and accounts payable tool.

Employees can request goods or services, and Saldor routes each request through the appropriate approval, security, legal, and finance workflows.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104430&key=user_uploads/1733940/50e219d2-f23a-4531-b6f6-1c4410b188d2)

Our AI agent communicates directly with vendors to collect documents, follow up on quotes and delivery dates, and keep records updated automatically.

Saldor can then generate purchase orders, track receipts, process invoices, and match bills against what was ordered and received.

Teams can also interact with Saldor through MCP and connect it to their ERP, accounting system, or other internal tools.

**The Team**

Jack and Jacob worked together as Crusoe building AI infrastructure before leaving to start Saldor. Jack (CTO) holds a B.S in Computer Science from Carnegie Mellon University. Jacob (CEO) holds a B.S in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

launches.body:
Hi YC 👋 we're Rishi and Tushar, and we're building Waybill (<https://waybill.to>).

**TL;DR:** Waybill runs procurement for hardware and deep-tech companies, end to end. An engineer tells us what part they need. Our agents and humans source it anywhere in the world, get quotes, handle payment, shipping, customs, last mile, log it into inventory and match the invoices. One system of record from request to stock. We don’t stop at the ‘order placed’. We make sure it reaches your shelf. A few crazy things Waybill was asked to source & order -

1. A lifetime supply of an obsolete RF component
2. Cessna aircraft. Yes, real airplanes
3. Industrial Robots

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/JPxhZFZ5xco>

**Backstory**

I (Rishi) ran operations at LAT Aerospace (Deepinder Goyal’s aerospace startup) as part of their founding team. On paper, that meant "sourcing." In practice, it meant finding jet engines, flight controllers, high-density batteries, and satellite radios for a very ambitious aerospace program, then moving machinery and merchandise worth millions across borders, and finding and operating real estate you can actually fly aircraft from. I also handled government liaisoning, which is a polite way of saying I convinced the world's harshest bureaucracy to approve things it didn't have a form for, like taking off and landing an aircraft in under 50 meters.

Tushar has been working the other end of this problem his whole career. At WareIQ (YC S20), he built the autonomous inventory system behind 400+ Indian D2C brands - forecasting demand and making buying decisions across thousands of volatile SKUs without blowing up working capital.

So between us: I've spent my career buying hardware the hard way, and Tushar's spent his teaching machines to manage inventory. Waybill is both jobs in one system.

**The problem**

Hardware engineers spend a big chunk of their week buying parts. They can't hand it off to operations folks, because only the engineer who specified the part knows which alternates are acceptable. And finding parts is genuinely hard: stock is scattered across distributor catalogs, resellers, and Alibaba listings, and packaging suffixes, obsolete part numbers, and regional inventory make the same part look like six different parts. It's a search, not a lookup.

All of this runs on email, WhatsApp, and spreadsheets. No system of record, and context dilutes at every handoff. Parts land late, arrive undocumented, or get bought twice. I know because at LAT, _I was the system of record_. It didn't scale.

**What we built**

An engineer tells Waybill what they need. Our agents find every authorized distributor and manufacturer rep stocking that part anywhere in the world, request quotes and lead times, and rank the options by what the customer actually cares about. A defence company only wants suppliers from allied nations. A medical device company needs provenance. Everyone else wants the right balance of cost, lead time, and complexity.

If no distributor has it, our network in India, China, and Southeast Asia finds it. If a supplier can't ship to the customer's country, we pick up the box and ship it ourselves.

Once the order is placed, our agents prepare the customs paperwork, a licensed broker files it, parts are received into inventory automatically, and the invoice is automatically matched against the PO and import documents. The next time someone asks for that part, the agent says it's already on the shelf.

And when a customer moves from R&D to production, the same system scales with them. Demand comes off the BOM and build schedule - reorder points, second sources, volume pricing - and we already hold every order, price, and lead time they've ever had.

Most procurement software ends at an approved PO. We end at a physical part on a shelf, customs-cleared and invoice-matched.

Rippling made the employee the first-class object and built every service around it. We're doing the same for the part.

Here are a few crazy things engineering teams asked Waybill to procure in the two weeks that we’ve been live -

1. A lifetime purchase of an obsolete RF component
2. Cessna aircraft. Yes, real airplanes.
3. Industrial Robots

**Where this goes**

A hardware company should be able to ask us for anything physical and get it. Today that's parts. Next it's PCB fab and assembly, CNC machining, 3D printing, tooling, trucking, warehousing, and allocation on ships and planes. The interface never changes: say what you need, and it arrives.

**Asks**

1. Hardware and deep-tech founders - we want to run your procurement. Comment, DM, or email me at [rishi@waybill.to](mailto:rishi@waybill.to). We’re company size agnostic.
2. Intros to procurement leads at hardware enterprises. If you know one, we'd love a connect.

**Ask for it and it shows up. Take your supply chain for granted.**

name: Derya
long_description:
Derya deploys supply chain automations for startups, SMEs, and enterprises that fulfil their entire supply chain function, from prospecting and procurement to distribution of goods.

Our mission is to rebuild the supply chain from the ground up, turning one of the world’s hardest coordination problems into an AI native system that moves commodities by being integrated into both the supply chain infrastructure and the customer. We work across robotics, commodities, and food & beverages companies; procuring goods and managing various operation functions for them.

launches.body:
TL;DR: We map out all your procurement, logistics, assembly, and distribution operations and then execute them for hardware companies. If you build hardware, physical AI, robots, we'll set up the operations while you focus on designing your product and sales.

**Ask:** If you are spending too much time sourcing components, managing manufacturers, or coordinating shipments, let's see how we can save time and make money for you. Reach us at [contact@usederya.com](mailto:contact@usederya.com) or book a meeting at[ https://calendar.app.google/vSabvozH51TCM9V18](https://calendar.app.google/vSabvozH51TCM9V18) 

<https://youtu.be/ZcWtJmPZjVo> 

**The Problem**

Redundant labor and inefficiencies represent $1.3 trillion of the $13 trillion logistics market. You shouldn't be spending your Tuesday chasing a customs broker, comparing three carrier quotes you don't trust, and hoping your parts clear China customs before your build slips a week.

**Solution**

We’re setting up your supply chain for you:

* **Shipping & customs automation** for cheaper and risk-free freight and imports
* **Procurement** support to autonomously order, ship, and track all your inputs
* **Production** visibility and execution to get your products ready to ship, quick

**Why us**

We already handled more than $15M in freight before starting to handle the whole supply chain for companies ranging from lab robotics to biochemical manufacturers.

We’ve been friends for almost 10 years and built our first business together in high school. Mert was the CTO of the trucking AI company Hemut (YC P25), UCLA CS major, and the son of a ship captain. He built software for 25+ ships, a $450M fleet running on his software. 

Oguzhan is an Oxford law grad who worked at CMA CGM/Ceva (3rd-largest shipper), previously built a six-figure-ARR AI-native business, and grew up in a farming family, providing him exposure as both the carrier and the customer.
